raw_content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "prioritize_mechanism_over_automated_cxr_findings", "description": "When clinical mechanism suggests high-energy blunt trauma, do not rely solely on negative or non-specific automated CXR tool outputs for mediastinal assessment.", "applicable_conditions": "Cases involving high-energy blunt trauma mechanisms (e.g., deceleration, crush) where automated chest X-ray interpretation tools return normal or non-specific findings regarding the mediastinum or aorta.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the clinical history indicates high-energy blunt trauma (e.g., motor vehicle collision with deceleration) and automated tools (`chest_xray_classifier`, `chest_xray_report_generator`) report 'normal mediastinum' or non-specific findings: (1) Recognize that automated tools often lack sensitivity for subtle mediastinal widening or aortic contour abnormalities; (2) Explicitly flag the case for manual expert review focusing on mediastinal width and aortic knob integrity; (3) Do not rule out blunt aortic injury based solely on these automated outputs."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
